questions.question: Which .NET runtime component executes managed code and provides garbage collection?
questions.explanation: The CLR provides the execution environment and memory management for managed code.

questions.question: What compile-time type does C# infer for var retryCount = 3;?
questions.explanation: A literal such as 3 fits int, and var infers that static type.

questions.question: Which return type represents a C# asynchronous operation that produces an Invoice?
questions.explanation: Task<T> represents eventual completion with a value of type T.

questions.question: Given string? city = null;, what does city ?? "Unknown" evaluate to?
questions.explanation: The null-coalescing operator returns its right operand if the left operand is null.

questions.question: Which assignments are valid for a variable declared int? count;? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: A nullable int can hold an int value or null.

questions.question: What happens to stream declared with using var stream = File.OpenRead(path); when its scope exits?

options.d: The contents are copied to a global variable

questions.explanation: A using declaration disposes the object at the end of its scope.

questions.question: What does new[] { 2, 4, 6 }.Where(n => n > 2).Select(n => n + 1) yield when enumerated?
questions.explanation: Where keeps 4 and 6, then Select adds 1 to each.

questions.question: Which ASP.NET Core service lifetime shares one instance within a request scope?
questions.explanation: A scoped registration uses one instance per scope, normally one per web request.

questions.question: In ASP.NET Core middleware, what does await next(context) invoke?

options.c: The next delegate in the request pipeline

questions.explanation: Middleware calls the next delegate to pass the request down the pipeline.

questions.question: Which actions support cooperative cancellation of an ASP.NET Core request? Select all that apply.

options.a: Pass the request token to a database API that accepts it
options.b: Ignore the token once the first await starts
options.c: Check the token during a long CPU loop

questions.explanation: Token propagation and periodic checks give downstream work a chance to stop.

questions.question: Which EF Core method asks a query to skip tracking returned entities?
questions.explanation: AsNoTracking opts the query out of ordinary change tracking.

questions.question: A tracked EF Core entity is edited. Which DbContext method applies the detected change to the database asynchronously?
questions.explanation: SaveChangesAsync writes pending tracked changes.

questions.question: Which C# statement rethrows the active exception from a catch block while preserving the original stack trace?
questions.explanation: A bare throw rethrows the current exception and preserves its original stack trace.

questions.question: What does Task.WhenAll(first, second) represent?

options.a: Completion of whichever task finishes first
options.b: A cancellation token for both tasks
options.c: A task that completes once both input tasks have completed
options.d: A scheduler that forces the tasks to run sequentially

questions.explanation: WhenAll completes after all supplied tasks finish and reflects their faults or cancellations.

questions.question: Which claims about standard .NET collections are true? Select all that apply.

options.a: A Queue<T> dequeues the earliest enqueued item that remains
options.b: A Stack<T> pops the oldest pushed item first
options.c: A List<T> may contain duplicate values
options.d: A HashSet<T> deliberately stores every duplicate insertion

questions.explanation: Queues are FIFO, and lists permit duplicates.

questions.question: Which dependency commonly gives an ASP.NET Core consumer strongly typed access to an options object named MailOptions?
questions.explanation: The options pattern binds configuration to a type and exposes it through options interfaces.

questions.question: Which C# modifier on an ordinary base-class method permits a derived class to override it?
questions.explanation: virtual marks the base method as overridable.

questions.question: Which LINQ method immediately materializes a query into a list?
questions.explanation: ToList enumerates the query and collects the results now.

questions.question: Which ASP.NET Core feature matches request paths against endpoint route templates?
questions.explanation: Routing selects endpoints using metadata such as path templates.

questions.question: Which practices fit an asynchronous database operation inside an ASP.NET Core handler? Select all that apply.

options.b: Propagate the request cancellation token if the API accepts it
options.c: Use .Result to block until every I/O operation finishes
options.d: Start the write and ignore its outcome

questions.explanation: Await observes completion and errors, and a propagated token allows cancellation.
